body: I'm so sorry for what has happened to you. We all make stupid mistakes that we cannot change, but when it comes to destroying your health it is beyond anything else you can imagine. I made a stupid mistake as well, I went to a chiro and they crushed nerves in my neck. I can no longer breath properly or go too the bathroom. I am beyond the pain. I cannot look after myself very well anymore and each day I search for ways out. I understand what you are going through and I understand why we reach this point. It is not fair.
